work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Core contributor across all four Turbot open-source products (Steampipe, Powerpipe, Flowpipe, Tailpipe) — 120+ merged pull requests and 4,200+ commits across 79 repositories, with 9,300+ combined GitHub stars.

Designed and developed an internal REST API microservice in Go using the Gin framework to power the backend of Turbot Guardrails, a Preventive Security Posture Management (PSPM) SaaS product; secured endpoints with JWT client-token authentication, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for several internal microservices.

Engineered core features for Tailpipe, a Go-based observability CLI on DuckDB + Parquet, lifting log-processing throughput 30% to 1,000+ logs per second by chunking and batching file reads and streaming writes to DuckDB; reduced memory use to eliminate out-of-memory failures.

Led the AWS SDK for JavaScript v2 to v3 migration across 180+ call sites and 11+ AWS services in production Node.js Lambdas, refactoring discovery, configuration-sync, tagging, and resource-cleanup workflows; kept the platform supported past AWS SDK v2 EOL and unblocked the Node.js runtime upgrade.

Added multi-distro Linux smoke tests (ephemeral environments) for Turbot's Go CLIs to the GitHub Actions release/CI-CD pipeline, hardening release safety and catching regressions across Linux distributions before deployment.
Resolved a production incident by diagnosing a Go service stuck in a Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff, collaborating with the platform team to investigate pod logs and status and restore service.

work.name: Trisetra, Inc.
highlights: Led the user-upload workflow redesign across 60+ files in React (Google Maps autocomplete, drag-and-drop upload, history dashboard, invite-code sign-up, improved empty/error states), driving increased user engagement.

projects.name: Lila Tic-Tac-Toe — Real-Time Multiplayer Game
projects.description: Built end to end in 4 days. React 19 + TypeScript + Vite on Vercel; Nakama game server (Go core + TS runtime) on Fly.io with PostgreSQL. Server-authoritative anti-cheat over WebSocket transport, mode-aware matchmaking via KV-storage queues, tick-based turn timer, and a top-10 leaderboard.
